notice: The toolkit's reading of which requirement each control contributes to. It is evidence for an auditor to weigh, not a judgement of compliance: a requirement is met by an organisation's measures as a whole, which one workstation's settings never show. Review the mapping against the editions your organisation follows.

controls.method: Each fixed drive's protection status, encryption method and key protectors, from Get-BitLockerVolume, against the fixed disks of Win32_LogicalDisk.
The antivirus products registered with Windows Security Center (root\SecurityCenter2, AntiVirusProduct) and Microsoft Defender's state (Get-MpComputerStatus).
The age of Microsoft Defender's signatures: AntivirusSignatureLastUpdated from Get-MpComputerStatus.
Microsoft Defender's path, process and extension exclusions (Get-MpPreference), judged by how much they leave unscanned.
IsTamperProtected from Get-MpComputerStatus.
The Attack Surface Reduction rules configured and their action: AttackSurfaceReductionRules_Ids and AttackSurfaceReductionRules_Actions from Get-MpPreference.
EnableLUA and ConsentPromptBehaviorAdmin under HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System.
The MicrosoftWindowsPowerShellV2 optional feature, from Get-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online.
NoDriveTypeAutoRun under HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\Explorer.

InactivityTimeoutSecs under HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System, otherwise the session's ScreenSaveActive, ScreenSaverIsSecure and ScreenSaveTimeOut under HKCU\Control Panel\Desktop.
Confirm-SecureBootUEFI.
Win32_Tpm in root\CIMV2\Security\MicrosoftTpm: present, enabled, activated, and its specification version.
VulnerableDriverBlocklistEnable under HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\CI\Config, with the Device Guard state (Win32_DeviceGuard).
Hypervisor-protected code integrity configured and running: Win32_DeviceGuard in root\Microsoft\Windows\DeviceGuard.
UseLogonCredential under HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\SecurityProviders\WDigest.
RunAsPPL under HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa.
Credential Guard configured and running (Win32_DeviceGuard), and whether the edition (EditionID) supports it.
CachedLogonsCount under HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon, and whether the machine is joined to a domain (Win32_ComputerSystem).
Each firewall profile's state and default inbound action, from Get-NetFirewallProfile.
The SMB1Protocol optional feature, from Get-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online.
RequireSecuritySignature of the SMB server and client, from Get-SmbServerConfiguration and Get-SmbClientConfiguration.
LmCompatibilityLevel under HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa, with the level Windows applies when it is absent.
NtlmMinClientSec and NtlmMinServerSec under HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa\MSV1_0.
EnableMulticast under HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows NT\DNSClient.
The Spooler service's state and start type (Get-Service), and the printers installed (Win32_Printer).
fDenyTSConnections under HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Terminal Server.
UserAuthentication under HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Terminal Server\WinStations\RDP-Tcp, when Remote Desktop is on.
The WinRM service (Get-Service) and its listeners (WSMan:\localhost\Listener).
The built-in guest account, by its security identifier ending in -501, from Get-LocalUser.
The members of the local Administrators group (S-1-5-32-544), from Get-LocalGroupMember, less the accounts the operator excluded.
The minimum password length of the local policy, as net accounts reports it.
The lockout threshold of the local policy, as net accounts reports it.
The enabled local accounts whose password never expires, from Get-LocalUser, the built-in accounts set apart.
A Windows LAPS policy (HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Policies\LAPS) or a legacy LAPS policy (HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft Services\AdmPwd).
The installation date of the newest update, from Get-HotFix.
PauseFeatureUpdatesEndTime and PauseQualityUpdatesEndTime under HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\WindowsUpdate\UX\Settings.
The Windows edition, release and build (registry and Win32_OperatingSystem), against the toolkit's catalog of Windows lifecycle dates.
EnableScriptBlockLogging and EnableTranscripting under HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\PowerShell.
The advanced audit policy (auditpol /backup), against the toolkit's baseline of subcategories.
